sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl.
Standing counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Berhampur P.S. Case No. 609 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 2178 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned JMFC, (R), Cog Berhampur for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/272/273 of IPC and read with Section 20 & 24 the Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products Act, 2003, 51/52/53 /58/57/59/63 of Food safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 103/104 of Trade Marks Act 1999.

entities.text: Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. The prosecution case is that the police conducted raid on the house of one Rajesh Kumar Jena who was found to be the process of manufacturing several tobacco products without license.
On being interrogated, he gave out that the unit belongs to the petitioner.
5. Having regard to the nature of accusations and the materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
6. The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
